propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit one deterministic canonical pin for each direct child and prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID.

PlanRelationSnapshot collects artifact material fingerprints from the subject ticket and all inbound/outbound relations by scanning a full O(store) ticket state preload including archived tickets, resolving aliases before deduplication.

Pin collection executes before prerequisite LLM evaluation and returns unsigned INDETERMINATE with structured error (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, or store-read-failure) if any referenced target is unreadable or unresolvable.
tracker_head_sha() validates clean git state using status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then captures the 40-hex HEAD commit, raising store-read-failure for any git, IO, path, or output anomaly.

All plan-review signing paths (ordinary sign, progressive drift refresh, re-sign) wire collect_plan_relation_snapshot() and pass related_material to build_manifest(pins=...) to emit complete pin sets deterministically.
Legacy manifests without pins remain readable by parsers that authenticate the stored DSSE envelope, interpret non-pin fields, and ignore unknown pin lines without reconstruction or rehashing.
